support_study_result.interpretation: Exact weather/terrain reconstruction and mechanics screening succeeded, but the preregistered natural Protect/environment interaction had zero support after the existing persistent hidden-Choice admission filters.
support_study_result.decision: Do not increase the natural sample after observing zero support. Land the reconstruction capability and move the next falsifiable experiment to the utility/opponent-policy horizon.
